commands.review_summary:
The branch changes the macOS and Linux Antigravity PTY descriptor tests to wait for two newline-terminated output lines before asserting.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection plus the recorded failure shows current main can read result.txt after the first pwd line but before the descriptor status append; I did not run the flaky test because this review is read-only.

target.title: [codex] Stabilize Antigravity PTY output tests
target.body:
## Summary
- Wait for the Antigravity PTY descriptor probe to finish writing both output lines before asserting.
- Apply the same stabilization to the macOS and Linux copies of the test so both lanes avoid the same partial-file read race.

## Behavior proof
A macOS CI shard previously observed the probe output after `pwd > result.txt` but before the descriptor status append completed:

```text
Expectation failed: (lines → ["/Users/runner"]) == ([NSHomeDirectory(), "closed"] → ["/Users/runner", "closed"])
± removed ["closed"]
```

The probe script writes the working directory first, then appends `closed` or `inherited`. Waiting only for `result.txt` to exist can read the first line early, so the tests now poll until both lines are present before the final exact assertion.

After-fix focused test output, run locally on branch `c5b3a0587f92` after rebasing onto `daba50847e18`:

```text
$ swift test --no-parallel --filter '(^CodexBarTests\.AntigravityCLISessionTests/)'
...
✔ Test "pty launcher uses home and closes unrelated descriptors" passed after 0.013 seconds.
...
✔ Suite AntigravityCLISessionTests passed after 0.039 seconds.
✔ Test run with 48 tests in 1 suite passed after 0.040 seconds.
```

## Validation
- `swift test --no-parallel --filter '(^CodexBarTests\.AntigravityCLISessionTests/)'`
- `.build/lint-tools/bin/swiftformat Tests/CodexBarTests/AntigravityCLISessionTests.swift TestsLinux/AntigravityProcessLauncherLinuxTests.swift --lint`
- `.build/lint-tools/bin/swiftlint --strict Tests/CodexBarTests/AntigravityCLISessionTests.swift TestsLinux/AntigravityProcessLauncherLinuxTests.swift`
- `.build/lint-tools/bin/swiftlint --strict`
- `git diff --check`
